scientific_stage: M2-A4 GP level-set search and diverse public-I1-compatible portfolio construction
purpose: Systematically explore the public-I1-compatible inverse set after M2-A2 showed that adaptive TPE missed remote high-quality solutions, then extract a small diverse portfolio before any further graph composition.

warm_start.note: Only 25-trajectory public-I1 losses measured on the original M1 search seed bank enter the GP training set.

level_set.ceiling_source: M2-A2 existing_geometry.compatibility_mse_ceiling, which was frozen from the pre-A2 TPE best loss

gp_model.kernel: ConstantKernel * Matern(nu=2.5, ARD length scales) + WhiteKernel

provisional_portfolio.eligibility: Observed 25-trajectory local MSE must be <= the frozen provider-specific level-set ceiling.
provisional_portfolio.first_member: lowest observed local MSE; ties by candidate_id
provisional_portfolio.remaining_members: greedy maximin Euclidean distance in normalized (log mu, log kappa, CV); ties by lower local MSE then candidate_id

confirmation.reference_source: previous M2-A confirmation results, frozen before M2-A2/A3/A4
confirmation.selection: Take the first three confirmation-compatible members in the precomputed provisional portfolio order. Do not reorder using confirmation MSE.

stop_rule: Do not alter the frozen level-set ceiling, add extra GP evaluations beyond the 48-per-provider budget, or automatically enlarge the provisional portfolio if fewer than three members per provider pass confirmation. Stop and review the local public-I1 design explicitly.
graph_gate: Hold M2-B2 and any new graph composition until the M2-A4 final confirmed portfolio is frozen.
